results.evidence: Any change of control of the Customer shall be deemed an assignment requiring the Supplier's prior written consent.
For purposes of this schedule, "Company" as defined in the Agreement shall include all Affiliates of the Company.
Either party may terminate by giving written notice no fewer than ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
This letter shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of its courts.
